title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Monthly Rate Sheet
content:
Every light rented under **Area and Security Lighting Rental** carries a monthly rental for the fixture, with the energy included, and a separate monthly rental for each additional pole set for that light. The rates below are per light and apply to all seven fixtures the cooperative rents, the four LED fixtures offered for new installation and the three legacy fixtures still maintained on older poles.

## Monthly rental rates

| Fixture | Monthly rental, energy included (USD) | Monthly rental for each additional pole (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 9.85 | 4.75 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 12.40 | 4.75 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 17.95 | 6.20 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 22.60 | 6.20 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 11.25 | 4.75 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 19.80 | 6.20 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 13.10 | 4.75 |

## Rate terms that apply to every fixture

| Term | LED 40W, 70W, 110W, 150W | HPS 100W, HPS 250W, Mercury Vapor 175W |
|---|---|---|
| The rental includes the energy the fixture uses | Yes | Yes |
| The power cost adjustment is billed on the fixture's estimated monthly kWh | Yes | Yes |
| Sales tax on the rental follows the sales tax percentage of the rate schedule of the service account the light is billed on | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the sheet

- The additional-pole rate falls into two levels. The LED 110W Flood Light, the LED 150W Flood Light and the HPS 250W Flood Light carry 6.20 per additional pole per month; the LED 40W Security Light, the LED 70W Area Light, the HPS 100W Security Light and the Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light carry 4.75.
- A light mounted with no additional pole has no pole rental; the pole rate is counted once for each additional pole set for that light.
- The monthly rental is a flat figure per fixture. The energy the fixture burns is part of that figure, so the rental and the energy are not two different rates on this sheet.
- No rental tax percentage is printed here: the percentage is the one the billing service account's own rate schedule carries.
